findings.target_and_state: Dense settings panel in static screenshot state
findings.title: Dense presentation may increase avoidable cognitive effort

evidence.description: The screenshot shows many equally weighted controls without progressive disclosure.

reproduction_steps: Count the simultaneously presented control groups and inspect their hierarchy.
findings.user_impact: People with attention, memory, or processing differences may need more effort to find and complete a task.
findings.recommended_repair: Test grouping, hierarchy, plain labels, defaults, and progressive disclosure with representative users.
verification_steps: Validate the task with representative users before calling the concern resolved.

evidence_log.description: Static visual evidence supports an advisory review request, not a normative failure.
